title: console: changing the command-palette query after record hits have loaded blanks the whole console (cmdk "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'forEach')")
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi7SkqaNxU2Ef8P2DMmp2hPJ)_

Found during an exploratory walkthrough of the showcase app.

## Environment

- objectui `main` @ `6fb31dc`, console served by `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console dev` (:5180)
- objectstack `main` @ `b9c7a8f`, `PORT=3000 pnpm dev` (showcase), signed in as the dev admin, locale zh-CN
- Chromium (Playwright), 1440×900

## Steps

1. Open any app page, e.g. `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task`.
2. Press Ctrl/⌘+K and type `Website`. Wait for the record hits (a 项目 group with *Website Relaunch*).
3. Change the query to something that returns a *different* set of record groups, either by select-all + typing `华宁` / `Co`, or by deleting the text with Backspace and typing `Contoso`.

## Expected

The palette shows the hits for the new query.

## Actual

The palette disappears and the **entire console unmounts to an empty page** (no shell, no sidebar); only a reload recovers. The page error is:

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'forEach')
    at .../node_modules/.vite/deps/cmdk.js:139:6
    at Set.forEach (<anonymous>)
    at z (.../cmdk.js:137:29)
    at .../cmdk.js:106:5
    at .../cmdk.js:483:28
    at Map.forEach (<anonymous>)
    ...commitHookEffectListMount (react-dom_client.js)
```

followed by React's "An error occurred in the <ForwardRef> component. Consider adding an error boundary…".

Reproduced on every attempt (2/2 for each of the sequences above). A fresh query typed into a newly opened palette works (`华宁`, `hn`, `Contoso`, `Data`, `设置` all fine), and so does extending a query (`Web` → `Website`). It is the switch from one record-group set to another that crashes.

## Reading of the cause (from the stack and the bundled cmdk 1.1.1 source, not debugged further)

cmdk's sort step (`z` in the minified build) walks `state.filtered.groups` and, for each id, reads that group's item set from its group map and calls `.forEach` on it. A `CommandGroup` that unmounts deletes its own map entry. In `CommandPalette.tsx` the record hits are rendered as one `CommandGroup` per object, keyed `records:<objectName>`, so when the new query stops returning an object that group unmounts while `filtered.groups` still names it, and the sort scheduled by an item's value change runs before the filter is recomputed. The lookup returns `undefined` and throws inside a layout effect.

Two separate things make it worse than a broken palette:

- nothing above the palette catches the error, so one bad search takes down the whole console;
- the record-group set is exactly the part of the palette that changes on every query, so ordinary use hits it.

## Suggested direction

Make the record groups stable across queries (or let the async record hits bypass cmdk's own sort/filter, since their order and membership already come from `/api/v1/search`), and put an error boundary around the palette so a palette failure cannot unmount the shell.
